svg.title: Request and control flow
svg.desc: Same-origin request validation, command admission, durable execution, prepared reads, and truthful UI state.

a.xlink:title: User. Uses Pocket Lab Lite through the browser.
a.text: Uses Pocket Lab Lite through the

a.xlink:title: Browser. Hosts the installed or web PWA and enforces browser-origin boundaries.
a.text: Hosts the installed or web PWA and

a.xlink:title: React / Vite PWA. Renders Lite screens and sends same-origin requests only to FastAPI through Caddy.

Frontend state ownership. Combines service worker, TanStack Query, Dexie safe snapshots, Zustand UI-only state, XState guided flows, API client, error boundaries, and generated fixtures without owning backend truth.
FastAPI /api/lite/*. Validates requests, owns safe read APIs, admits commands, and never delegates browser execution directly to NATS or shell.
Identity, authentication, and invite guards. Applies identity guards, duplicate checks, protected-host checks, and fail-closed invite/bootstrap acceptance.
Fleet, Apps, Security, Recovery, and Release APIs. Exposes domain-specific read and command endpoints while preserving backend-owned lifecycle execution.
Prepared read, health, readiness, diagnostics, and evidence APIs. Serves side-effect-free prepared projections, health/readiness, compact diagnostics, and sanitized evidence lookups.
SQLite control-plane store. Stores canonical Lite lifecycle state and prepared projections; the frontend never accesses it directly.

Audit index, projection refresh, prepared projections, and domain revisions. Indexes audit evidence and tracks dirty signals, generations, committed projections, current-state summaries, and semantic revisions.
NATS / JetStream. Provides the command and event backbone with durable delivery; it is never contacted directly by the frontend.
Worker process. Consumes durable commands and owns backend execution for apps, security, recovery, releases, and lifecycle work.
Command admission and lifecycle. Tracks admission, queued, claimed, running, terminal, acknowledgement, retry, and dead-letter behavior independently from device lifecycle.
Completion and audit evidence. Records sanitized lifecycle and completion evidence for commands, devices, apps, security, recovery, and releases.
Caddy same-origin proxy. Serves the PWA and routes /api/lite/* and managed app paths without exposing backend secrets.
